empty: No condition cards — access follows other bindings only
excludeTip: Negates the whole card: grants access only when its conditions are NOT met (blacklist semantics)
hint: Filled modules within a card must all hold (AND); empty = any. E.g. "employee set + role" = member of the set AND holding that role. Permission groups / employee sets pick existing dictionary items (created under System → Permission groups); any matching card grants access (OR); "Exclude" negates the whole card
setNotFound: No employee sets yet — create one under System → Permission groups → Employee sets
groupNotFound: No permission groups yet — create one under System → Permission groups
usersPlaceholder: Specific users: search name / employee no., empty = any
orTip: Cards combine with OR: any matching card grants access; a card marked Exclude works the other way — it grants only when it does NOT match
andTip: Modules within a card combine with AND: every filled module's condition must hold
modsTip: Check the modules this card uses; unchecked modules do not participate in this card (unchecking clears their filled values)
modsEmpty: No modules checked on this card (validation will reject it on save — check and fill at least one)
rolesTip: Multi-select; holding any selected role satisfies this module
postsTip: Multi-select; holding any selected post satisfies this module
usersTip: Search by name / employee no. to restrict to specific users
groupTip: References an existing permission group; its members satisfy this module
setTip: References an existing employee set; member employee numbers satisfy this module
